The '''1934 [[Turkish Football Championship]]''' was the fifth edition of the competition. It was held in October. [[Beşiktaş J.K.|Beşiktaş]] won their first national championship title by defeating [[Altay S.K.|Altay]] 3–1 in the final after [[overtime (sports)|overtime]].<ref>{{cite book|last=Yüce|first=Mehmet|title=İdmancı Ruhlar: Futbol Tarihimizin Klasik Devreleri (1923 - 1952)|issue=2|publisher=iletişim|pages=302–304|language=tr}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.angelfire.com/nj/sivritepe/5758/TB.html|title=Türkiye Futbol Birinciliği|publisher=Erdinç Sivritepe|access-date=31 December 2017}}</ref> For Altay it was the club's first appearance in the championship final, with one more to follow in 1951.

The various regional champions competed in a group stage of five groups of three to six teams each, with the group winners advancing to the Final Phase.
